Image-guided radiotherapy

Concept for a Fan-beam Computed Tomography Image-guided Radiotherapy Device

Vincent Weidlich; Lawrence Lechuga; Dennis Dore; Georg A Weidlich; Bill Nighan

Published
2019-06-11
Journal
Cureus. 2019;11(6):e4882.
DOI
10.7759/cureus.4882

Paper summary

A proposed radiotherapy device combines a 6 MV linear accelerator with fan-beam CT guidance. The paper describes the Simple XRT concept and considers equipment cost and shielding requirements in the design of a treatment system.

The article presents a device concept. This summary does not establish current commercial availability, regulatory approval or clinical effectiveness.
